items.title: HT Substation Erection (Up to 33 kV / 132 kV)
items.spec: Complete turnkey supply, erection, testing, and commissioning of indoor and outdoor HT substations as per utility norms.

items.title: Overhead HT/LT Transmission Lines & Pole Structures
items.spec: Installation of RCC/RSJ spun poles, double/four-pole structures, GOS, horn-gap fuses, insulators, guysets, and conductor stringing.

items.title: HT Metering Cubicles & Ring Main Units (RMU)
items.spec: Supply and installation of incoming/outgoing isolator RMUs, 11 kV breakers, HRC fuse switches, metering cubicles, and HT cabling.

items.title: Distribution Transformer Installation (Indoor / Outdoor)
items.spec: Installation, earthing, oil filtration, and commissioning of 11/0.433 kV distribution transformers with complete statutory protection.

items.title: HT/LT Power Cabling, Cable Trays & Bus Ducts
items.spec: Structured laying, glanding, termination, and jointing of armoured HT/LT cables with GI/HDG cable trays and rising mains/bus ducts.

items.title: Industrial, Commercial & Multistoried Electrification
items.spec: Complete internal wiring, concealed/false-ceiling circuits, UPS networks, machinery power points, and indoor/outdoor lighting.

items.title: Power Control Center (PCC) Panels
items.spec: Custom-fabricated 16 SWG CRCA dust- and vermin-proof PCC panels with multi-tank pre-treatment for main power distribution.

items.title: Motor Control Center (MCC) & Star-Delta Panels
items.spec: Compartmentalized MCC, DOL, and Star-Delta starter panels engineered for industrial motors, pumps, HVAC, and process loads.

items.title: Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC) Panels
items.spec: Microprocessor-controlled automatic/manual capacitor bank panels maintaining power factor at or above 0.90–0.99.

items.title: VFD, PLC & Automation Control Panels
items.spec: Variable frequency drive and PLC-integrated control panels for precision motor speed control and process automation.

items.title: AMF, ATS & DG Synchronization Panels
items.spec: Auto Mains Failure (AMF) and Auto Transfer Switch (ATS) panels ensuring seamless generator changeover during utility outages.

items.title: MCB Distribution Boards & Outdoor Feeder Pillars
items.spec: Weatherproof outdoor feeder pillars and modular MCB/MCCB distribution boards with double gasketing for lighting and power circuits.

items.title: DG Set Installation, Earthing & Commissioning
items.spec: End-to-end sizing, foundation coordination, acoustic/ventilation setup, neutral/body earthing, testing, and Inspectorate approval.

items.title: Generator Cooling & Exhaust Systems
items.spec: Erection and commissioning of remote radiators, heat exchangers, cooling towers, and compliant exhaust piping for industrial generators.

items.title: Lightning Detection, Protection & Surge Protection (SPD)
items.spec: Conventional and ESE lightning arresters paired with low-voltage, signaling, and data surge protection devices for critical facilities.

items.title: Maintenance-Free Earthing & Exothermic Welding
items.spec: Chemical/copper-bonded maintenance-free earthing systems and exothermic-welded earth grids tested for low soil resistance.

items.title: Security Systems, Fire Wiring & Data Cabling
items.spec: Structured fire-alarm wiring, CCTV/security system cabling, telephone networks, and computer communication infrastructure.

items.title: Preventive/Breakdown AMC & Inspectorate Liaisoning
items.spec: Rapid breakdown response, scheduled preventive maintenance for HT/LT/DG assets, and Chief Electrical Inspectorate safety approvals.
